digest.component_or_area: caused_by link events and blame derivation
propositions: caused_by edges lack a provenance field to distinguish blame-derived guesses from explicitly supplied attributions, causing metrics to weight them identically.
The provenance field must be optional with values 'derived' (blame auto-derivation) or 'explicit' (operator/agent-supplied), with old unmarked events reading as unknown.
transition_close._apply_caused_by must populate provenance as 'explicit' when --caused-by is non-empty and 'derived' when the culprit comes from blame.derive_caused_by.
rebar link caused_by and add_dependency must mark caused_by writes as 'explicit'.
The reducer and metrics layer must surface the provenance field present-only on dep entries and expose per-edge provenance counts via the bug_caused_by_provenance dimension.
